newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks falter slightly in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks falter slightly in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks faltered slightly in in early morning trade on Tuesday due to small-lot selling, with the market unable to recover from the heavy losses it accumulated on the previous day, brokers said.
They added that the down-side should be limited as bargain hunting was expected.

About half an hour after the open, the market's key Nikkei 225 average was down 20.47 points, or 0.10 percent, at 20,654.22. In the futures market, the benchmark December futures were down 10 points at 20,670.
"The market is basically in a wait-and-see mood and participants are few, and arbitrage-linked selling could become a burden," a "Big Four" brokerage broker said.
